description: This file contains functions and types for resolving and managing web tools configuration, including search and fetch providers, secret resolution, and diagnostics handling within a web runtime environment.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object and not an array.

methods.name: normalizeProvider
methods.description: Normalizes a search provider string and verifies it against available providers.

methods.name: normalizeFetchProvider
methods.description: Normalizes a fetch provider string and verifies it against available fetch providers.

methods.name: hasCustomWebSearchPluginRisk
methods.description: Determines if the configuration has custom web search plugin risks based on load paths, installs, or allow/deny lists.

methods.name: readNonEmptyEnvValue
methods.description: Reads the first non-empty environment variable value from a list of names.

methods.name: buildUnresolvedReason
methods.description: Builds a string explaining why a secret reference is unresolved or invalid.

methods.name: resolveSecretInputWithEnvFallback
methods.description: Resolves a secret input, falling back to environment variables if necessary, and handles secret ref resolution.

methods.name: ensureObject
methods.description: Ensures a nested object exists at a given key within a target object.

methods.name: setResolvedWebSearchApiKey
methods.description: Sets the credential value for a web search provider in the configuration.

methods.name: keyPathForProvider
methods.description: Returns the credential path for a given web search provider.

methods.name: readConfiguredProviderCredential
methods.description: Reads the credential value for a provider from configuration or provider-specific methods.

methods.name: inactivePathsForProvider
methods.description: Returns secret paths that are inactive for a provider based on credential requirements.

methods.name: setResolvedWebFetchApiKey
methods.description: Sets the credential value for a web fetch provider in the configuration.

methods.name: keyPathForFetchProvider
methods.description: Returns the credential path for a given web fetch provider.

methods.name: readConfiguredFetchProviderCredential
methods.description: Reads the credential value for a fetch provider from configuration or provider-specific methods.

methods.name: inactivePathsForFetchProvider
methods.description: Returns secret paths that are inactive for a fetch provider based on credential requirements.

methods.name: hasConfiguredSecretRef
methods.description: Checks if a value has a configured secret reference.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeWebTools
methods.description: Main function that resolves web tools configuration, including search and fetch providers, secrets, and diagnostics, returning metadata.
